verdict.rationale: GoDaddy publishes downloadable OpenAPI JSON specs at stable URLs for Domains v1, v2, and v3, and for Commerce APIs (stores, customers, orders, channels, catalog, taxes). Its llms.txt explicitly lists the 'Domains v3 OpenAPI spec — machine-readable Domains contract', making the specs discoverable to agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of spec completeness and validity (e.g., successful client generation).
